stories.title: Off-court turmoil and on-court woes: How the Knicks' title defense got chaotic -- fast
stories.summary: New York has stayed in the headlines -- for all the wrong reasons. Can the 2026 champs bounce back?

stories.title: MLB proposes delaying salary cap until 2028 amid start of free agency, labor uncertainty
stories.summary: Major League Baseball has proposed delaying the implementation of a salary cap until 2028 while it puts into place other elements of its labor offer for 2027.

stories.title: Cardinals rookie RB Love placed on IR, out 4-5 weeks with high ankle sprain
stories.summary: Cardinals running back Jeremiyah Love was placed on injured reserve because of a high ankle sprain that will sideline the rookie for four to five weeks.

stories.title: Missouri's Drinkwitz: 'I'm not a candidate' for Florida State job
stories.summary: Missouri coach Eli Drinkwitz said in no uncertain terms Tuesday that he is "not a candidate" for the open Florida State job.

stories.title: Minter makes it official, says rookie QB Fagnano will start for Ravens vs. Jags
stories.summary: Ravens rookie quarterback Joe Fagnano will start Thursday night's game against the Jaguars, coach Jesse Minter announced Tuesday.
